$comment: Downloadable CVs under public/resume/ that are pinned to an approved 1-page resume build instead of being generated from resume/*.md. tools/check-resume-pdf-drift.js fails CI if a pinned file's SHA-256 or page count changes, if a file listed here is missing, or if any served PDF contains a banned claim. To update a CV: copy the new approved PDF over the file, update sha256/pages/source/pinnedOn here, and commit both together.
